summary: Phase 149O.1E -- HATP Repository Identity + Trust-Store Foundation Implementation: implemented exactly Wave 1 and Wave 2 of the 149O.1D plan. Wave 1 (src/pcae/core/repository_identity.py, new): CRI Layer 1 repository-local random repository_instance_id (UUID4), strict schema/timestamp validation, atomic symlink-safe persistence, pcae init integration, .pcae/.gitignore entry; confers no authority by itself (verified via real git worktree add distinct-identity test, full-copy no-authority-concept test, path-move preservation test). Implements HATP-REQ-046..051, HATP-REQ-107. Wave 2 (src/pcae/core/hatp_bootstrap.py, new): CRI Layer 2 + read-only registry substrate -- HATPTrustStore (five read methods, zero mutation methods), DeploymentBinding/PrincipalRecord/SignerRecord/AuthorityRecord closed-schema models, canonical-deployment-root resolution, POSIX bootstrap-environment readiness classification. Production trust-store location (~/.pcae-hatp/trust-store) is outside repo/.pcae/**, accepts no path/env/CLI override; test injection is a private constructor parameter never reachable from .production(). Verified: same-ID-wrong-root and full-copy attacks resolve to no authorized deployment; revoked bindings never match; this repository's own live deployment mechanically reports UNSAFE_CONFIGURATION/agent_and_admin_share_os_principal, never READY, under every permission mode the test process itself controls. Implements HATP-REQ-006, HATP-REQ-030..045, HATP-REQ-052..066, HATP-REQ-086..089. Neither module imports rollback_approval_evidence.py, permission_broker*.py, mutation_permission.py, agent.py, or commands/agent.py. No proof/verifier/provider/RAE-integration code exists (Waves 3-7 untouched); no dependency added. Verdict: HATP WAVE 1 + WAVE 2 IMPLEMENTED -- FOUNDATION READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION. HATP-001 byte-unchanged; B-149O-1..4 remain OPEN (reproduced identically before/after via git-stash A/B comparison). See docs/PHASE_149O_1E_HATP_REPOSITORY_IDENTITY_TRUST_STORE_FOUNDATION_IMPLEMENTATION.md, tests/test_repository_identity.py (14 tests), tests/test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py (26 tests), and tests/test_phase_149o_1e_hatp_repository_identity_trust_store_foundation.py (11 tests), all passing.
